label: prf:markov-trace-ratio-exact
title: Proof of markov trace ratio exact
html:
Proof. Proof of markov trace ratio exact

Proof. The Jones polynomial of a braid closure \hat\beta on n strands is J(\hat\beta, q) = C(n, q) \cdot \mathrm{tr}_M(\beta) where C(n, q) = (-q^{1/2} - q^{-1/2})^{n-1} \cdot (-q^{-3/2})^{-w(\beta)} depends on the strand count n, the substrate parameter q, and the writhe w(\beta) — but the factor (-q^{-3/2})^{-w} also cancels in ratios of braids with the same writhe. For braids with different writhes, the writhe correction is a known power of q that can be applied post-hoc without affecting the Gram-matrix or LP structure.

The ratio J_1/J_2 = C \cdot \mathrm{tr}_1 / (C \cdot \mathrm{tr}_2) = \mathrm{tr}_1 / \mathrm{tr}_2 is immediate from cancellation of the common factor C. \square

Consequence for the HOMFLYPT engine. The the canonical formalism returns Markov-trace-normalised values at SU(2) (row 3 of rem:archimedean-image-table), which are proportional to the Jones polynomial. For all optimisation consumers — the canonical formalism, the canonical formalism, the canonical formalism — the ratios are exact and the LP shadow prices, Gram inverse, and Frobenius duals are normalisation-independent.

At SU(N > 2), the engine uses the quantum Schur function weights, which give a DIFFERENT invariant (the SU(N) quantum invariant, row 5 of the Archimedean-image table). The same ratio-exactness holds within each N-channel: the normalisation factor C_N(n, q) cancels in ratios.
